script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. LOS ANGELES - NIGHT

A futuristic metropolis. Dazzling neon lights illuminate the skyline. Hover cars zip through the air. People walk below, engrossed in their personal devices.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
In a world where time travel is a reality, second chances become a tempting obsession.

INT. HOME OFFICE - DAY

JAMES, 42, a brilliant scientist, hunches over a holographic blueprint. He's lost in thought, a worried expression etched on his face.

JAMES
(frustrated)
This can't be it. There's got to be a better way.

INT. JAMES' KITCHEN - NIGHT

James pours himself a glass of scotch. He sits at the table, staring at a photo of his ex-wife and young daughter.

JAMES
(to himself)
If only I could go back and do things differently...

INT. TIME TRAVEL LAB - DAY

James enters his lab, where his colleague, LUCY, 32, a passionate and dedicated scientist, awaits him.

LUCY
James, you're up late again. I thought we agreed on reasonable working hours?

JAMES
Lucy, I've made a breakthrough. I think I've found a way to manipulate time without causing paradoxes.

INT. TIME TRAVEL LAB - NIGHT

James and Lucy work together, their hands a blur as they fine-tune the device.

LUCY
But why, James? What's driving you to do this?

JAMES
(sighs)
I just want a second chance. To make things right.

INT. TIME TRAVEL CHAMBER - DAY

James steps into the time travel chamber, hesitant. Lucy stands by his side, her expression a mix of concern and excitement.

LUCY
Be careful, James. Remember, every action has consequences.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - YEARS AGO

James, younger and more carefree, sits across from his ex-wife, EMMA, 38. They share a laugh as they sip their coffee.

EMMA
(smiling)
You know, James, I've been thinking... I think I'd like to give our marriage another chance.

JAMES
(elated)
Really? That's all it takes?

INT. TIME TRAVEL CHAMBER - DAY

James exits the time travel chamber, a hopeful expression on his face.

JAMES
(to himself)
It worked.

INT. HOME OFFICE - DAY

James sits at his desk, looking at his holographic blueprint. A smile spreads across his face.

JAMES
(to himself)
Now, let's see if I can make this invention a success...

INT. HOME - NIGHT

James and Emma sit in their living room, their daughter playing at their feet. They look at each other, their eyes filled with love.

JAMES
(whispering to Emma)
I'm glad I got that second chance.

INT. TIME TRAVEL LAB - NIGHT

James and Lucy celebrate their success, surrounded by their colleagues.

LUCY
(raising her glass)
To second chances.

All laugh and clink glasses.

FADE OUT.
